learning_outcomes.text: Apply adequate methods to solve problems
Develop algorithms and write code (Python, C++, etc.)
Propose solutions to an open problem and criticise them
Evaluate the performances of the proposed solutions
Present the solutions during an oral presentation

teaching_methods: Work in small groups, supervised by a tutor

assessment_methods.method: Project grade (achievements, written document, oral presentations, interactions, work organization, reflection on organization, mastery of topics and concepts)

assessment_rules: The final grade depends on the project grade and an individual written test. The weight of the written test is 25% if the grade is 10 or more, and 100% if the grade is 6 or less. For grades between 6 and 10, the weight depends linearly on the grade: weight = 1 - 0.75*(grade - 6)/4. The project grade can be individualized based on student implication. Activities related to the project grade cannot be re-taken in the second session. The second session consists of an individual exam, which may require preparing individual work beforehand.
degree: Bachelor in Engineering (Bachelier en sciences de l'ingénieur, orientation ingénieur civil) - FSA1BA
